name: Smith Machine Single-Arm Row
steps: Stand beside the low bar with your feet staggered, then hinge forward and brace your free hand on your front thigh.
Grasp the center of the bar with your working arm extended and release the hooks.
Pull the bar straight upward along the rails toward your side hip by driving your elbow close to your ribs.
Lower the bar smoothly back to full arm extension, rerack safely, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your shoulders square to the floor rather than twisting your torso upward as you pull.
Grip the exact middle of the bar so it glides evenly along the guide rails without binding.
